content_sections.heading: About District Health Society, Sivagangai
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Sivagangai works under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu. These posts are for its National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme team. The District TB Officer directs the Radiographers' work, and the team runs from the District TB Centre on the Old Government Head Quarters Hospital Campus in Sivaganga.

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Sivagangai Radiographer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The wage is paid at Rs. 680 per day for 25 days a month. The engagement runs for 8 months, from August 2026 to March 2027. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.pay: Rs. 17,000/- per month (Rs. 680 x 25 days) plus Rs. 3,000/- per month mobility support

content_sections.heading: District Health Society Sivagangai Radiographer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be below 45 years of age. BSc in Radiography / Diploma in Radiography. Only residents of Sivaganga District are eligible to apply. Candidates who have relevant experience must send their experience certificate with the application. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Take chest X-rays for TB screening with handheld or mobile X-ray equipment, following the set protocols, radiation safety standards and infection prevention practices. Provide X-ray services during Active Case Finding (ACF), Passive Case Finding (PCF), outreach activities, screening camps, health melas and special drives, as the District TB Officer (DTO) directs. Label X-ray images correctly and upload or transfer them on time through the designated digital platform so they can be read and acted on. Work with Medical Officers, STS, STLS, TB Health Visitors and other field staff on referral, sputum or sample collection and follow-up of people identified as presumptive TB. Keep accurate records and send daily reports to the DTO or NTEP district team: people screened, X-rays taken, activity location and type, presumptive TB cases, referrals and other indicators. Maintain the X-ray equipment, keep it ready for use and report any malfunction, damage, shortage or technical problem straight away. Help the DTO plan and map X-ray-based TB screening activities, and help validate, reconcile and report screening data. Attend NTEP training, review meetings and monitoring activities, and follow the technical, radiation safety, confidentiality and patient privacy rules. Coordinate with the three Directorates at district level and with Block Medical Officers to plan and run camps. Operate HHX Ray units in Active Case Finding campaigns among high-risk and hard-to-reach populations, and make sure screened people are linked to diagnosis and treatment services. Do any other TB screening, diagnosis and case-finding work that the District TB Officer or District Health Officer assigns.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications are checked first. Candidates found eligible are told about the interview by post. Applications are summarily rejected if they arrive after the last date, if the required documents are missing, or if details are incomplete.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District Health Society Sivagangai Radiographer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from sivaganga.nic.in . Fill in every detail in the form. Attach the documents listed below, including a self-addressed envelope (4 × 10 inches) with a Rs. 10 stamp on it. Send the application only by post to: The Deputy Director of Medical Services (TB), District TB Centre, Old Government Head Quarters Hospital Campus, Sivaganga – 630 561. Make sure it arrives by 10 November 2026. faq.question: Q1. How many Radiographer posts are there in Sivagangai?
faq.answer: There are 2 Radiographer posts under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme. They are filled on daily wages.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: You need a BSc in Radiography or a Diploma in Radiography.

faq.question: Q3. Can candidates from other districts apply?
faq.answer: No. Only residents of Sivaganga District are eligible, and you send a Ration Card or Voter ID with the application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: You must be below 45 years of age.

faq.question: Q5. How much does the job pay?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 680 a day for 25 days, which is Rs. 17,000 a month. On top of that you get Rs. 3,000 a month for mobility support.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: It runs for 8 months, from August 2026 to March 2027.

faq.question: Q7. Where do I send the application?
faq.answer: Send it by post to The Deputy Director of Medical Services (TB), District TB Centre, Old Government Head Quarters Hospital Campus, Sivaganga – 630 561.

faq.question: Q8. What envelope do I need to include?
faq.answer: Include a self-addressed envelope of 4 × 10 inches with a Rs. 10 stamp on it.

faq.question: Q9. How will I know if I am called for interview?
faq.answer: The applications are checked first, and eligible candidates are informed about the interview by post.

faq.question: Q10. What work will a Radiographer do?
faq.answer: You will take chest X-rays for TB screening with handheld or mobile X-ray units at camps, health melas and Active Case Finding drives. You will also send daily reports to the District TB Officer.
